expenditures.detail: 4 Schedule B rows sum to 100.00 + 100.00 + 50.00 + 250.00 = 500.00 exactly = the corrected page subtotal = the printed total = the cover's Column A = line 6. ⚠ THE FILER CORRECTED HIS OWN SUBTOTAL ON THE PAGE AND THE CORRECTION IS THE ONE THAT CLOSES: a 1400 dpi crop shows '$ 250 00' written on the Subtotal line and STRUCK THROUGH with a long diagonal, with '$500 00' written above it. 250.00 is exactly the sum of the first three rows (100 + 100 + 50), so the struck figure is his subtotal BEFORE he added the fourth line, the 8/18/2010 250.00 repayment to himself. Handwritten corrections over struck values govern (per-row rules), the corrected 500.00 is what every other printed figure on the filing agrees with, and the struck 250.00 is retained here rather than discarded.
